issue.title: Add Cloudflare to Flask Hosting Platforms docs?

summary.text: This is an open documentation request to add Cloudflare Workers and its Flask deployment guide to Flask’s “Hosting Platforms” documentation. A maintainer initially noted that the linked guide’s examples repository lacked the referenced example; the reporter subsequently said it had been merged.

Please keep the entry concise and consistent with the existing platform listings, and ensure the guide and example links are stable.
